spec.title: 开场影片·写实关键帧提示词
spec.styleAnchorZh: 日式动画电影背景美术，精细手绘厚涂，赛璐璐人物 + 厚涂写实背景，黄昏逆光，暖橙与冷蓝紫对比，空气透视，浅景深，细微的浮尘颗粒，胶片颗粒感，生活质感与磨损痕迹
spec.styleAnchorEn: Japanese anime film art, finely hand-painted thick impasto background, cel-shaded characters over realistic painted backgrounds, golden-hour backlight, warm orange against cool blue-violet, atmospheric perspective, shallow depth of field, fine floating dust motes, subtle film grain, lived-in wear and tear
spec.negativePrompt: 像素, 像素风, 8-bit, 马赛克, 复古游戏, 3D渲染, CG, 塑料感, 光滑无纹理, 照片, 写实照片, 真人摄影, 粗黑描边, 矢量扁平, 过度简化, Q版, 低幼, 大头娃娃, 动漫大眼, 夸张表情, 萌系, 变形的手, 六指, 多余手指, 反折的关节, 文字, 英文单词, 字母, 水印, 签名, 边框, 商标, logo, 过度饱和, HDR, 艳俗, 霓虹, 赛博朋克, 魔法阵, 宝石, 锁扣, 华丽装饰, 发光符文
constraints: 全片只有一个十岁中国男孩；镜2只露侧后45°，镜10远景正脸一次
画面不出现任何英文单词、字母、标志或水印
书与铅笔按文档 PROP-BOOK / PROP-PENCIL 设定，旧、哑光、普通
镜4和镜6不使用任何光效；镜6保留约0.6秒静音悬念
光柱、浮尘、扫光、墨痕、星星粒子由 Remotion 代码叠加，不要求生成模型绘制
spec.promptAssembly: Combine spec.styleAnchorEn + item.prompt + spec.negativePrompt for generation; preserve all color and framing constraints.

referenceAssets.prompt: Character design sheet, three views (front / side / back) of the same Chinese boy, 10 years old, slim, about 140cm, round oval face with a slightly pointed chin and baby fat, short black hair covering the ears with slightly flipped tips and one stray fringe strand, thick short eyebrows with flat ends, MONOLID eyes with a large sclera and a small dark iris (realistic child proportions — do NOT enlarge the eyes), skin #f0c9a0, mouth closed and neutral. Wearing a navy school track jacket (#2b3a5c) with a white collar and white sleeve stripes and a small chest badge, zipper half open, white crew-neck t-shirt, dark blue-grey track pants with a white side stripe, slightly dirty white sneakers, and a brick-red backpack (#8c3a3a) with reflective strips. Slight slouch, shoulders drawn in. Japanese anime film character design, cel-shaded flat colors with clean thin line art, plain white background, no shading gradient, full body, standing.
referenceAssets.negativePrompt: 动漫大眼, 少年漫画帅哥, 挺拔姿势, 多角色, 文字, 英文单词, 水印, 变形手, 六指

referenceAssets.prompt: Close-up of a realistic 10-year-old child's hand, back of hand facing up, five fingers slightly separated and relaxed, resting on a worn wooden school desk; correct child anatomy, clean thin cel-shaded line art over thickly painted desk, warm low sunset sidelight, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, no objects, no text.
referenceAssets.negativePrompt: 六指, 多余手指, 反折关节, 成人手, 文字, 英文, 水印, 魔法光

referenceAssets.prompt: Close-up of the same child's hand, thumb and index finger gently pinching an object, other three fingers naturally curled, exactly five fingers, correct joints, realistic child proportions, cel-shaded hand over thickly painted background, warm sunset sidelight, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, no magic glow, no text.

keyframes.description: 放学后的空教室：左侧窗户、右侧三排旧木桌、黑板一角，夕阳光柱中有尘埃，没有人物。
keyframes.prompt: Japanese anime film background art, finely hand-painted, thick impasto rendering. An EMPTY Chinese primary school classroom at dusk after class. A row of windows along the left wall; low golden-orange sunset light slants in from the left, casting long window-pane light patterns across the floor; fine dust motes float inside the light shafts. On the right, three rows of worn wooden desks recede into depth. A corner of a blackboard with half-erased chalk marks at the far left edge. Unlit fluorescent tubes and a ceiling fan on the ceiling. White walls tinted warm orange by the sunset. Warm orange key light against cool blue-violet shadows, atmospheric perspective, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, melancholic quiet mood. NO PEOPLE. NO TEXT.

keyframes.description: 男孩从右侧走入，背影/侧后45°，肩膀微内收，脸藏在窗光暗部。
keyframes.prompt: Japanese anime film still, cel-shaded character over thickly painted background. A 10-year-old Chinese boy seen from behind at a 45-degree rear three-quarter angle entering an empty classroom at dusk. He is backlit by low golden sunset light from the left window, his face in shadow and not visible. Short black hair covering the ears with slightly flipped tips. Navy school track jacket (#2b3a5c) with white collar, zipper half open, dark blue-grey track pants, slightly dirty white sneakers, brick-red backpack (#8c3a3a) with reflective strips. His shoulders are drawn in and his posture is slightly rounded. Fine dust motes in the light, shallow depth of field, warm orange and cool blue-violet shadows, subtle film grain. Face NOT visible.

keyframes.description: 同机位，男孩坐下从砖红书包掏东西，仍不露脸。
keyframes.prompt: Japanese anime film still, cel-shaded character over thickly painted background. The same 10-year-old Chinese boy seen from behind at a 45-degree rear three-quarter angle, now seated at a worn wooden school desk in an empty classroom at dusk. His face remains in shadow and not visible. Short black hair covering the ears with slightly flipped tips, navy school track jacket (#2b3a5c) with white collar and half-open zipper, brick-red backpack (#8c3a3a) with reflective strips slumping on the desk, one hand reaching into the bag. Shoulders drawn in and back slightly rounded. Fine dust motes, shallow depth of field, warm orange light, cool blue-violet shadows, subtle film grain. Face NOT visible.

keyframes.description: 45°桌面俯视，旧木桌和普通课本，中间小一圈的深蓝布面书离桌约2cm，边缘青白微光。
keyframes.prompt: Japanese anime film background art, finely hand-painted thick impasto rendering. Close three-quarter overhead view of a single worn wooden school desk tilted about 45 degrees. The wood has grain, carved scratches, ballpoint pen marks and leftover adhesive from removed stickers. Two or three shabby textbooks with curled corners and faded blank name labels sit aside. In the exact center a smaller A5 hardcover book with a dark navy cloth cover, worn matte surface, most gold foil rubbed away, frayed whitened corners, hovering about 2cm above the desk with a very faint pale cyan-white rim of light. Low golden sunset light from the lower-left, window-pane patch across the desk, shallow depth of field, warm orange and cool blue-violet shadows, subtle film grain. NO PEOPLE. NO TEXT.

keyframes.description: 手部特写，旧深蓝布面书摊开，两页暖白空白、纸纤维和极淡擦痕，HAND-1在右页边。完全无魔法光。
keyframes.prompt: Japanese anime film still, cel-shaded hand over thickly painted background. Extreme close-up of a worn dark navy cloth-bound book lying open on a wooden school desk, both visible pages completely blank, warm off-white paper (#f7f1e6) with visible paper fibre texture and extremely faint erased-pencil smudges at about 10% opacity. A child's hand rests at the edge of the right page, back of the hand facing up, realistic child proportions, clean simple line art. Low golden sunset light from the left. NO magic glow at all — the book looks completely ordinary. Shallow depth of field, subtle film grain. NO TEXT. NO WRITING.

keyframes.description: 同机位，手指快速翻页，翻起的页自然弯曲并带轻微动态模糊；不加光效。
keyframes.prompt: Japanese anime film still, cel-shaded hand over thickly painted background. The same worn dark navy cloth-bound book is open on a wooden school desk, several warm off-white blank pages caught mid-turn with natural curved paper and slight motion blur. A realistic child's hand with five fingers turns the pages. Visible paper fibre texture and barely perceptible erased smudges, ordinary unmagical book, low golden sunset sidelight, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain. NO MAGIC GLOW. NO TEXT. NO WRITING.

keyframes.description: 逆光，手把书举向窗边，书页边缘透出橙红，只有很弱的一瞬亮。
keyframes.prompt: Japanese anime film still, cel-shaded hand over thickly painted background. A child's hands hold a small worn dark navy cloth-bound book up toward a classroom window at dusk. The book is ordinary and matte; the warm off-white page edges show their thickness and fibres with a restrained orange-red translucency from the sunset backlight. No face, no text, no ornate decoration. Japanese anime film art, finely hand-painted thick impasto background, warm orange against cool blue-violet, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain.

keyframes.description: 书脊极近特写，布面起毛、边角发白、旧压痕，拇指和食指沿书脊摸到后停住。背景虚成色块。

The cloth is visibly frayed and pilled, corners rubbed white, fine fabric fibres catching low golden sidelight, one old deep crease running down it. Two fingertips of a child's hand (thumb and index finger) rest on the spine. Background completely out of focus, reduced to soft warm and cool color blocks. Very shallow depth of field, subtle film grain. NO TEXT.

keyframes.description: 从书背后抽出普通旧铅笔，木色六棱杆、磨损漆面、钝石墨尖、粉色旧橡皮和灰箍，不发光。
keyframes.prompt: Japanese anime film still, cel-shaded hand over thickly painted background. Close-up of a child's hand pulling an ordinary worn wooden pencil out from behind a dark navy cloth-bound book. The pencil has a hexagonal natural wood barrel (#e8c88a) with lacquer worn away in patches, a blunt already-used graphite tip (#5a5560), a pink rubber eraser (#e88b95) worn down on one corner, and a grey metal ferrule (#b8bcc4). The pencil is completely ordinary — NO glow, NO sparkle, NO magic effect. Warm low sunset sidelight, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain. NO TEXT.

keyframes.description: 正俯90°空白书页，纸纤维和极淡擦痕，钝铅笔尖悬在上中，手从画面上沿进入。
keyframes.prompt: Japanese anime film still, perfectly top-down 90 degree view of a single blank page of an old book filling the frame. Warm off-white paper (#f7f1e6) with visible fibre texture and barely perceptible erased smudges at 10% opacity. The blunt tip of an ordinary wooden pencil hovers just above the paper near the upper centre, held by the edge of a child's hand entering from the top of the frame. Soft even lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain. NO TEXT. NO WRITING. NO GLOW.

keyframes.description: 同机位，笔尖画完一条略歪的墨黑弧线，手正在抬起；发光扫线由 Remotion 叠加。
keyframes.prompt: Japanese anime film still, perfectly top-down 90 degree view of a single blank warm off-white page of an old book. Visible paper fibre texture and extremely faint erased smudges. A blunt ordinary wooden pencil has just drawn one slightly uneven black arc across the page, and the child's hand is lifting away at the top edge. Soft even lighting, subtle film grain, no glow baked into the image. NO TEXT. NO WRITING.

keyframes.description: 手画五角星从纸面浮起，墨黑变暖金，脱离纸面悬浮，线条略歪；唯一一次急推。

It rises from a warm off-white book page, initially ink black then turning warm gold (#f5c542) with a bright rim light (#fff3c4), subtle paper-like thickness to the edges, soft outer glow. Japanese anime film style, cel-shaded with thick painted rendering, isolated subject, no text, no shadow on the ground.

keyframes.description: 星星停住后散成暖金/冷青光点，孩子的手在下方虚焦，回到俯拍书页只剩发光墨痕，渐白。
